title: dangote refinery drives seven fold rise nigeria petroleum product exports eia 2026 08 24
text:
Aug 24 (Reuters) - Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, as output from the Dangote refinery improved regional fuel trade ​flows and boosted supplies to Europe and Africa, the U.S. ‌Energy Information Administration said on Monday.
